title: Recursively unmount directories
summary: Unmount a directory and all subdirectories mounted within it. Useful when you have nested mounts and want to clean them up in one go.

steps.explain: Unmount the specified directory and any filesystems mounted inside it recursively.

placeholders.name: MOUNT_POINT
placeholders.description: The path to the top-level directory containing nested mounts.

warnings: Ensure no applications are using files in any of the nested mounts, or the operation may fail or cause data loss.

rollback.explain: Remount the filesystems individually using the mount command.
